teaser: What do you do with a mind that keeps asking why, housed in a heart that keeps asking is this good? Life path 7 is the seeker, built for solitude and the long interior argument with itself. INFP is the quiet idealist, loyal to feeling over logic, the one who trusts an inner compass over a shared map. Crossed, they do not compete so much as crowd the same room: both already prefer the inside of the head to the noise outside it. The particular weather here is a double retreat — intellect pulling toward the mystery, feeling pulling toward the private truth of it, and neither one especially eager to come out and report back.
excerpt: Eleven at night, the wedding reception thinning out, and you are the one still at the table when the band has stopped, turning a glass slowly, thinking about what the vows actually meant versus what everyone clapped for.
